_meta.description: EXAMPLE brand token map for pdf-designer. Copy to storage/brands/brand-<yours>.json and replace values. Contains no personal data.
_meta.source: Replace with a pointer to your website profile, e.g. www-theme-kit/profiles/<site>.json
_meta.privacy: This file is tracked on purpose as a template. Real brand maps belong in gitignored storage/brands/.

_paletteRuleNote: On LIGHT, do not darken warm amber/gold accents — that turns brown. Hand the warm-highlight role to another hue already in the palette (violet, teal, blue, magenta).
